players.product: SMR designer - Doosan Enerbility forging/material supplier and prospective module manufacturer

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (CFO): NuScale reported revenue of $31.5 million for the year ending December 31, 2025 compared to $37 million in the prior year; the decrease was due to lower revenue recognized on the RoPower technology licensing agreement, partially offset by higher Fluor Phase 2 engineering and services revenue. Overall liquidity rose to $1.3 billion at December 31, 2025, versus $754 million at September 30, 2025 and $442 million at the end of 2024. The number of Class B shares was greatly reduced in Q4 as Fluor converted its NuScale B shares into Class A common stock and continues to monetize its stake via open market transactions.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue $31.5 million vs $37 million; liquidity $1.3 billion at December 31, 2025 vs $754 million at September 30, 2025 and $442 million at end of 2024

quarterly_data.signal: Cash outlook (CFO): after a post-close payment of about $250 million (disclosed in Note 9), 'we can assume about $1 billion of cash on balance sheet today.' Excluding onetime items, OpEx 'stays fairly consistent between $170 million to, call it, $200 million, closer to $193 million actually in 2024 on an adjusted basis.' NuScale does not give guidance; the CFO said burn rate or runway 'is not a problematic item for us' and pointed to the partnership milestone agreement filing for the further milestone payments under the developer-led model.
quarterly_data.figure: post-close payment of about $250 million; about $1 billion of cash; OpEx between $170 million to $200 million, excluding onetime items (closer to $193 million in 2024, adjusted)

quarterly_data.signal: TVA / ENTRA1 program (CEO): the 6 gigawatts TVA agreement announced last September would represent a total deployment of 72 NuScale Power Modules and 6 ENTRA1 Energy plants across TVA's 7-state service region. Progress NuScale understands has been made: ENTRA1 is assembling a team of design engineers, a construction contractor, owners' engineers, investors and legal advisers; several major financial institutions are in project-financing discussions and '1 major institution has already signed a multibillion dollar term sheet with ENTRA1'; site visits and evaluations are underway; the prospective site for the first plant has been identified; and drafting of a definitive PPA is underway. The new TVA Board was confirmed in January. The General Counsel declined further detail on the term sheet, citing an NDA with ENTRA1, and said nothing beyond the prepared remarks could be said about the PPA.
quarterly_data.figure: 6 gigawatts = 72 NuScale Power Modules and 6 ENTRA1 Energy plants; 1 multibillion dollar term sheet signed

quarterly_data.signal: Business model (CEO): NuScale is an asset-light technology provider with its NRC-approved SMRs; 'Currently, Doosan Enerbility is our primary manufacturing arm' and NuScale chose not to manufacture the reactors or develop the plant infrastructure. ENTRA1, its exclusive global commercialization partner, is the development arm responsible for financing, project development and deal execution, installing NuScale SMR technology in its own power plants. ENTRA1 was named on the U.S.-Japan framework fact sheet (Japan's $550 billion commitment) as the only American SMR power plant developer; Japan has been NuScale's second largest investor since 2022, and TVA and NuScale have had a relationship for almost a decade. The CEO said the TVA-ENTRA1 program would support fast-growing energy demand for AI data centers.

RoPower (Doicesti, Romania): by the end of 2025 NuScale completed its FEED 2 work for Fluor Corporation on the 6 module SMR plant, and 'NuScale recognized $63.1 million in revenue from licensing fees and engineering work from the FEED 2 study over an 18-month period ending in December 2025.' NuScale anticipates pre-EPC activities to begin in the second quarter of 2026 with an estimated duration of up to 15 months, including a Class 2 cost estimate. The CEO stressed NuScale is a subcontractor whose contract is with Fluor, not the Romanian government, that Fluor is in negotiations with RoPower, and that NuScale is waiting for Fluor and RoPower to do their deal as the next step.
quarterly_data.figure: $63.1 million revenue from licensing fees and FEED 2 engineering over an 18-month period ending December 2025; pre-EPC up to 15 months from Q2 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Revenue after a TVA PPA (CCO): once ENTRA1 and TVA sign the PPA, NuScale expects to enter COLA and FEED activities that generate revenue, and the CCO said he 'would expect to be more than what we see in RoPower just because the size of the plants are much larger.' The CEO said the sale of NPMs to ENTRA1 will make up the largest percentage of NuScale's future revenues, complemented by licensing, installation, commissioning and post-COD plant services.

Regulatory and markets: the NRC approved NuScale's 77-megawatt electric standard design ahead of schedule; the CEO said NuScale remains the only SMR technology with NRC design certification (under 10 CFR Part 52) and has 12 modules in production. The CCO said the 77-megawatt approval lets ENTRA1 push its pipeline, and that NuScale is the only nuclear technology certified by the NRC for behind-the-meter, off-grid applications, which NuScale will pitch for powering data centers. The CEO named three target markets: coal plant refurbishment, process heat/steam for industrial plants, and hyperscalers ('the elephant in the room'). New use cases: an Oak Ridge National Laboratory techno-economic assessment of NuScale modules supplying steam and power to a U.S. chemical facility, an Idaho National Labs study, a high-temperature steam compression demonstrator with Ebara Elliott Energy, and an Oak Ridge project using AI to enhance fuel efficiency for multi-module plants.
quarterly_data.figure: 77-megawatt standard design approved; 12 modules in production

players.product: gas turbines & SMR for data-center power

connects_to.relationship: Doosan Enerbility supplies forgings/materials for NuScale SMR modules and is bidding for module equipment manufacturing

contracts.signal: NuScale COO: 'We have 12 modules under production right now' at Doosan, with long lead materials already ordered, giving NuScale a significant timing advantage on any project. 'We have extreme confidence with Doosan'; Doosan is 'increasing their capacity so they can move up to 20 modules per year and then eventually doubling that capacity.' The COO said these 12 modules 'will set the stage for the next set of 12 modules that could be used with the ENTRA1 projects.'
contracts.units: 12 modules under production; capacity up to 20 modules per year, then doubling
